description: Source code for a GUI widget class 'file_chooser' used in the Battle for Wesnoth project, handling file selection dialogs including directory navigation, file listing, and user interaction.

classes.name: file_chooser
classes.description: A GUI widget class for browsing and selecting files and directories.

methods.name: display_current_files
methods.description: Displays the list of files and directories in the current directory.

methods.name: display_chosen_file
methods.description: Updates the filename textbox with the currently chosen file.

methods.name: process_event
methods.description: Handles user input events such as mouse and keyboard interactions.

methods.name: entry_selected
methods.description: Handles the event when a directory or file entry is selected.

methods.name: entry_chosen
methods.description: Handles the event when a directory or file entry is double-clicked or confirmed.

methods.name: get_current_file
methods.description: Returns the current filename or path as a string.

methods.name: choice_made
methods.description: Returns whether a file choice has been made.

methods.name: update_location
methods.description: Updates the layout of the widget components based on a rectangle area.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Extracts the directory path from a file or directory string.

methods.name: get_path_up
methods.description: Goes up a specified number of directory levels from a given path.

methods.name: strip_last_delim
methods.description: Removes the trailing delimiter from a path string.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if a path is the root directory.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Joins a directory path with a filename or subdirectory.

methods.name: update_file_lists
methods.description: Refreshes the internal lists of files and directories in the current directory.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Processes SDL events for user interaction.
